cohort: The study included 300 pregnant women (150 with normal AFI and 150 with borderline AFI) recruited from the 29 Bahman Hospital in Tabriz-Iran.
finding: Pregnant women with borderline AFI were significantly more likely to report decreased fetal movement (OR = 7.43) compared to those with normal AFI, but no significant differences were found in Non-Stress Test or Biophysical Profile results between the two groups.
